text: {"rulings": [{"id": "1", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Sarah running fortnightly demos in the past and her leaving Halcyon last week are both true; her departure explains why the demos ended but does not falsify that they happened."}, {"id": "2", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Sarah's past fortnightly demos are a finished event, and Marcus wanting weekly demos going forward is a current preference; both hold at once."}, {"id": "3", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Marcus taking over on Monday and Sarah having held fortnightly demos before that are both true and describe different points in time."}, {"id": "4", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Halcyon paying for CircleCI has nothing to do with Sarah's demo cadence."}, {"id": "5", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Marcus being the current PM does not conflict with Sarah having run demos earlier; both are true."}]}
